title: Tour steps at 390x660 (the text of each dialog; the script waits for each step, then taps Next or Done)

steps.wait: role=dialog[name="Which team is yours?"] >> role=button[name=/^The Blue Tent/]

steps.click: role=dialog[name="Which team is yours?"] >> role=button[name=/^The Blue Tent/]

js:
(async()=>{const out=[];const names=['Suggestions','Ask','Your team','Menu'];for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let d=null;for(let k=0;k<40&&!d;k++){d=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].find(x=>x.innerText.startsWith(names[i]));if(!d)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}out.push('step '+(i+1)+': '+(d?d.innerText.replace(/
+/g,' | '):'none'));const b=d&&[...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/^(Next|Done)$/.test(b.textContent.trim()));b&&b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));}return '
'+out.join('
');})()
